rationale: EntityAllocator derives Default and its only field is `inner: remote_allocator::Allocator`, so the derive expansion calls Allocator::default(); World::default calls EntityAllocator::default(). rust-macro-invocation-call explicitly names #[derive(...)] expansion as the hidden-call pattern.
prior_verdicts_assessment: The fp-classifier-regression verdict naming rust-macro-invocation-call is correct.
